scientific_integrity.computational_scope: Finite program verifies small cases and explicit constructions; all-parameter proof is an elementary cancellation and parity argument.
scientific_integrity.historical_priority: Qualified best-knowledge comparison; primary recent preprints and equivalent Cayley sum formulation examined, but a 2007 different domination paper was available only by abstract and older equivalent formulations cannot be excluded.
scientific_integrity.limitations: Applies only to integer parameters \(r\ge2\) and \(n\ge4r\) with the full symmetric odd-jump interval, and only to total perfect/open-neighborhood codes. The base complete-bipartite classification is known; the all-lift rigidity is the new assertion.

title: Total perfect codes in odd-step circulant lifts: exact existence and enumeration
